responsibility: This target configuration header supplies the bare-metal/newlib-style ELF driver specs for NDS32 rather than Linux ABI behavior. It defines linker, library, and crt file selection policies, including default endianness handling, relax-related linker flags, and the constructor/destructor startup-file scheme controlled by -mctor-dtor or -mno-ctor-dtor, thereby telling GCC which startup and runtime objects to link for non-Linux NDS32 ELF targets.
